title: Redesigning How Software Gets Built With AI Agents — Sonar & McKinsey Panel
talk_summary: A Sonar/McKinsey panel argues that scaling agents requires redesigning end-to-end workflows, explicit context, and staged trust-building rather than token-maxing. The most concrete mechanism is a graduated autonomy ladder for PR review: observe, then block, then auto-fix, then auto-approve, then auto-merge, each unlocked by demonstrated precision.

takeaways.technique: Graduated autonomy ladder for PR gating
takeaways.what_they_do: Teams start by only observing agent review output and CI-failure analysis, then add blocking rules once precision is proven, then auto-fix, then scoped auto-approve, then auto-merge.
takeaways.evidence_quote: at first they just use reviews... over time when they see... these are very precise actual bugs... I'm going to now set up some rules to block

takeaways.technique: Measure reviewer precision to earn trust
takeaways.what_they_do: Autonomy is expanded only after users observe that agent findings are real bugs and fixes pass build without regressions.
They argue much design knowledge lives in engineers' heads and must be written down for agents to act correctly.
takeaways.evidence_quote: there's going to be a lot more that needs to be made explicit as opposed to implicit

takeaways.what_they_do: Sonar built PRD agents that capture requirements and generate the evals used for output verification.
takeaways.evidence_quote: PRD agents and how do we really capture what's in the PRD and use that to generate the e-vals

takeaways.what_they_do: They set up exemplar teams to establish best-practice agent workflows, then propagate, noting role-modeling alone is insufficient.
takeaways.evidence_quote: set up these lighthouse teams to really try and highlight the best practice ways of doing this

takeaways.technique: Measure end-to-end workflow metrics, not token spend
takeaways.what_they_do: Platform teams baseline PR throughput, cycle time, error/rework rate, and engineer sentiment before adding agents.
takeaways.evidence_quote: how fast am I able to ship code into production? What is the productivity of engineers in terms of throughput? What does the quality look like?
